benefits.name: United Hotels Credit
benefits.description: Up to $100 in statement credits per account year ($50 on first eligible United Hotels stay and $50 on second eligible stay of $50+ each).

benefits.name: Rideshare Statement Credit
benefits.description: Up to $60 per calendar year in statement credits ($5 per month) on eligible rideshare purchases. Enrollment required each calendar year.

benefits.name: Avis & Budget Travel Credit
benefits.description: Up to $50 per account year in United TravelBank cash ($25 after first eligible rental and $25 after second eligible rental) on Avis or Budget rentals booked via cars.united.com.

benefits.name: Instacart Credit
benefits.description: $10 Instacart credit each month (up to $120/year) with an active Instacart+ membership activated via Chase. Credit applies to one $10+ order per month.

benefits.name: United Club Passes
benefits.description: 2 one-time United Club passes per year (worth ~$59 each, $118 total but estimating usage of 1).
